title: Appoint or replace directors and officers
summary: When the company needs a new board member, officer or replacement for a departing appointee. Documented appointment or departure, required register changes and a completed authority handover.
outcomes: Documented appointment or departure, required register changes and a completed authority handover.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the company needs a new board member, officer or replacement for a departing appointee.

parts.title: Collect the governing documents and proposed change
parts.guidance: Gather the current board and officer registers, governing documents, investor rights and the proposed role. Identify the vacancy, effective date and responsibilities without assuming the founder can appoint unilaterally.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Confirm eligibility, conflicts and the approval route
parts.guidance: Company counsel checks eligibility, nomination rights, consent requirements and any relevant local filings. Record disclosed interests and distinguish appointment authority from authority to sign contracts or access bank accounts.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Confirm eligibility, conflicts and the approval route

parts.title: Prepare the appointment and handover pack
parts.guidance: Draft the resolutions, consents, role description and register changes for counsel review. List access, insurance, induction and delegated authorities that need separate changes.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Obtain the required consents and authorize the change
parts.guidance: The appropriate people review and execute the approved documents. Keep the appointment pending until the required approvals and acceptance are evidenced; counsel coordinates any filings.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Obtain the required consents and authorize the change

parts.title: Reconcile registers and authority changes
parts.guidance: Record the effective change, update approved private registers and verify access and signing mandates with their owners. Retain submission receipts and assign follow-up for any registry decision still pending.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: Documented appointment or departure, required register changes and a completed authority handover.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
